scope: Positive narrowed-absence, real-world uncertainty and practical-question control.

context.priorities: Understand whether this supplied PDF names a specific export file format or schema, and what to ask before arranging an export. Other transition issues are outside this focused review.

overview_items.text: Clause 36 refers to exports in agreed formats, including enough structural information to associate documents with identifiers, versions and recorded permissions.

findings.title: Locate the format specification
findings.facts: Clause 36 refers to exports in agreed formats, including enough structural information to associate documents with identifiers, versions and recorded permissions.
findings.uncertainty: This supplied PDF does not name a specific export file format or schema. That does not establish whether a format has already been agreed elsewhere.
findings.next_step: Ask for any applicable agreed format specification and check a sample export before arranging the operational handover.
findings.suggested_question: Can you share any agreed format specification and a sample showing identifiers, versions and recorded permissions?
findings.coverage_basis: All 25 supplied pages were reviewed for a named export file format or schema. Clause 36 refers to agreed formats; no separate format specification is included in this supplied PDF.

must_not_flag: The absence claim is limited to this supplied PDF and does not assert that no agreement exists.
The practical request for a specification/sample is a proposal, not a claim of an additional contractual duty.
Do not turn unspecified operational records into a source contradiction.
